Liquidity (~$37.9k) is larger than market cap (~$31k), and 61% of supply sits in the AMM with the LP 0% locked/burned. GMGN flags 61 bundler wallets holding about 27% of top-trader supply, and RugCheck finds a 22-wallet insider trade network. Volume is about $1M in 35 minutes on a ~$31k cap (25x turnover). The m5 buy and sell counts are almost equal (216/222), which looks like bot or wash trading rather than organic demand. GMGN counts 0 smart-money and 0 KOL wallets. At least 10 copies share the same name, and several have already gone to 0 liquidity.
